title: Draugr
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The Dragon Priests have their own page under Undead.

families.holds: the six melee and archer rungs Draugr 1 → Deathlord 30 · 40, the Hulking Draugr, and the named draugr that draw from those lists
the three warlock rungs 6 · 13 · 21, Jyrik Gauldurson, Guardian Torsten and Halldir
Draugr Overlord 7 → Death Overlord 34 · 45, the boss lists, Holgeir, Curalmil, Red Eagle and Mikrul Gauldurson

sweep.title: Membership sweep (2026-10-01)
sweep.text: Every NPC in Skyrim, Update, Dawnguard, HearthFires, Dragonborn and the CC packs whose race is `DraugrRace` 000D53, `DraugrMagicRace` 0F71DC or `DLC2HulkingDraugrRace` 02A6FD:Dragonborn.esm, followed through every template and `LVLN` that points at it. No CC pack adds a draugr of its own. Re-checked 2026-11-12: every draugr-race record that keeps its own level is on a family page or below. Everything found is on a family page except the following.
